artifacts.title: Model routing map
artifacts.notes: Flat KEY=VALUE lines consumed by bin/agent.bat. Not committed since FOC-779; bin/_lib.bat regenerates it when missing or older than models.json, and every start/watch refresh keeps it fresh.

artifacts.title: Dashboard UI build
artifacts.notes: Served by telemetry-server.mjs. The Docker image ships it prebuilt, so inside the container this entry is reported, never rebuilt.

artifacts.title: Atlas MCP config
artifacts.notes: Rendered from the template by bin/_lib.bat on every launcher start (the regenerate-on-start precedent). Reported only — the launcher owns it.

artifacts.title: Architecture diagrams (PNG)
artifacts.notes: The documented exception: the PNGs stay in git so GitHub readers see them, and the renderer needs Java. The registry only labels them stale.

artifacts.title: CodeGraph index
artifacts.notes: Freshness is delegated to scripts/code-intel.mjs status (its own HEAD-sha proof); the verdict is reported here, never managed.

artifacts.title: Telemetry analysis cache
artifacts.notes: Lives outside the repo tree under the telemetry home; status is delegated to GET /api/analysis/cache and reported here, never managed.
